reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. Sachets are a nice idea for travel, but I don't need a second magnesium and I'm not paying $30 a month to carry it.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and take it in the evening, so the 'to go' part solves a problem I mostly don't have. $29.99 for 30 days feels like a lot for something I can get in a regular bottle for less.
would_change_my_mind: A small travel pack (like 7 sachets) at a few dollars so I could try it on a trip without committing to a 30-day box.
